# Locality Guide: Hobart, Tasmania, Australia — Marriage Records ca. 1860–1910

## Jurisdictional Context

Hobart (standardPlace: `Hobart, Tasmania, Australia`) is the capital city of Tasmania. The jurisdiction passed through three names:
- **1804–1825**: Hobart Town, Van Diemen's Land, New South Wales, Australia — part of NSW
- **1825–1856**: Hobart Town, Van Diemen's Land, Australia — separate colony
- **1856–present**: Hobart, Tasmania, Australia — self-governing colony / state

For a marriage occurring in the 1885–1910 window (likely range for Francis Maria Fisher, b. 1871), the controlling jurisdiction is Tasmania, and all civil records are held at the Tasmanian Archives (Libraries Tasmania).

**Civil registration** of births, marriages, and deaths was introduced in Tasmania in **December 1838** at the colonial level. Earlier church records were retrospectively gathered by the Registrar General and incorporated into civil collections. There was no prior county- or district-level requirement — 1838 is when a statewide system began. (Source: https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Tasmania_Civil_Registration#History)

Tasmania population c. 1871: ~99,300 (growing to ~172,000 by 1901). Hobart was the largest city and administrative centre.

---

## Primary Records for Marriage Research

### 1. Tasmania Civil Registration — Marriage Registers (RGD 37 series)
**Access level: Indexed + images (93–97% name-indexed)**
- **FamilySearch collection 2125029** — *Australia, Tasmania, Civil Registration, 1803–1933* (414,523 records, 73,580 images). Primary collection covering all BMDs including marriages. Indexed and searchable by name. https://www.familysearch.org/search/collection/2125029
- Key marriage register volumes (RGD 37 series) from volume_search:
  - 1860–1862 (93% indexed), 1871–1874 (94%), 1883–1885 (96%), 1886–1888 (97%), 1891–1893 (96%), 1896–1897 (96%)
- The **Hobart civil registration image group** (007368132, 1839–1933, 285 images) is **98% indexed AND full-text searchable** — the highest-access resource specifically for Hobart.
- Tasmanian Marriage Certificates (RGD1 series) covering 1895–1910 are 100% searchable at FamilySearch.

### 2. Tasmania Civil Registration — District Registers
**Access level: Indexed + images**
- **FamilySearch collection 2514003** — *Australia, Tasmania, Civil Registration (District Registers), 1824–1939* (70,861 records, 192,461 persons, 21,141 images). Contains district-level registers, counterfoils of marriage certificates, and some church records. https://www.familysearch.org/search/collection/2514003
- Browse waypoints: https://familysearch.org/search/image/index#uri=https://familysearch.org/recapi/sord/collection/2514003/waypoints

### 3. Libraries Tasmania Names Index
**Access level: Free index + images (online)**
- **Marriages 1804–1899**: https://librariestas.ent.sirsidynix.net.au/client/en_AU/names/search/results?qf=NI_INDEX%09Record+type%09Marriages%09Marriages
- **Marriage certificate counterfoils 1852–1944**: same URL (select counterfoils sub-type)
- This is a critical parallel index maintained by the state archive — always search here alongside FamilySearch.

### 4. The Mercury Newspaper — Marriage Notices
**Access level: Index at Ancestry (subscription)**
- *Tasmania, Australia, Index to Marriage Notices in The Mercury, 1854–1962* — Ancestry collection 1647. Hobart's main newspaper; marriage notices often name both parties, date, and venue. https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/1647

### 5. FindMyPast — Tasmania Marriages
**Access level: Index + images (subscription)**
- *Tasmania Marriages, 1803–1899*: http://search.findmypast.co.uk/search-world-Records/tasmania-marriages-1803-1899

---

## Secondary / Corroborating Sources

### Cemetery Records
- *Australia, Cemetery Inscriptions, 1802–2005* (FamilySearch collection 2115584, 1.1M records)
- FindAGrave Tasmania: https://www.findagrave.com/cemetery/search?cemetery-loc=Tasmania%2C+Australia
- Cornelian Bay Cemetery (Hobart's main public cemetery) burial records 1893–1915 are digitized and partially indexed at FamilySearch.

### Newspaper Death/Probate Notices (to find marriage indirectly)
- *Tasmania, Australia, Index to Death Notices in The Mercury, 1854–1930* — Ancestry collection 1648 (death notices may reference spouse)
- *Australia, Tasmania, Government Gazette, 1833–1925* (FamilySearch collection 2170647, 101,074 images, browse-only) — probate and legal notices

### Directories (to locate the Holding family)
- Multiple Tasmania Post Office Directories at MyHeritage (1887, 1890–91, 1892–93, 1896–97, 1898, 1899, 1900, 1903, 1904) — useful to find Alfred George Holding's occupation and address
- Libraries Tasmania: Hotels & Properties index (1818–1958)

### Church Records
- Church marriage registers predate civil registration and supplement it. Digitized church registers on FamilySearch are concentrated in Launceston (Christ Church, Chalmers Free Church) and are **0% indexed / browse-only**. Hobart church records (Anglican St David's, Catholic St Joseph's, Wesleyan/Methodist, Presbyterian) would require Libraries Tasmania archival inquiry or browsing unindexed volumes.
- FamilySearch Wiki on Tasmania church records: https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Tasmania_Church_Records

---

## Access and Holdings Summary

| Record Type | Date Range | Access Level | Repository |
|---|---|---|---|
| Civil marriage registers (RGD 37) | 1838–1933 | Indexed + images (93–98%) | FamilySearch (collection 2125029) |
| District registers / cert counterfoils | 1839–1938 | Indexed + images | FamilySearch (collection 2514003) |
| Tasmanian Names Index — Marriages | 1804–1899 | Free index + images | Libraries Tasmania |
| Marriage cert counterfoils | 1852–1944 | Free index + images | Libraries Tasmania |
| The Mercury marriage notices | 1854–1962 | Index (subscription) | Ancestry (coll. 1647) |
| Tasmania Marriages | 1803–1899 | Index + images (subscription) | FindMyPast |
| Church registers (digitized) | 1840–1921 | Browse-only (0% indexed) | FamilySearch (mostly Launceston) |
| Tasmanian Archives (physical) | All dates | In-person or remote inquiry | Libraries Tasmania, Hobart |

---

## Research Tips for this Objective

1. **Start with FamilySearch collection 2125029** — search for "Fisher" + "Holding" in Tasmania marriages. The Hobart district image group (007368132) is full-text searchable.
2. **Cross-check Libraries Tasmania Names Index** for marriages and marriage certificate counterfoils — this is free and independently indexed.
3. **Search The Mercury marriage notices** (Ancestry 1647) for a Hobart announcement which would name date and parties.
4. If the marriage is found, **the marriage certificate** (via district registers, collection 2514003) will give: names, ages, residences, occupations, birthplaces, parents' names, witnesses, date, place, celebrant.
5. If no result in civil records, search **FindMyPast's Tasmania Marriages 1803-1899** as a parallel index before concluding nil.
6. Note: 906 digitized volumes for Tasmania marriages/vitals 1860–1910 exist on FamilySearch; only the first page of volume_search results was surveyed. The RGD 37 civil register series is the primary series and is well indexed.

## Proof Summary: Marriage of Frances Maria Fisher and Alfred George Holding, 23 February 1895

**Research question:** Did Francis Maria Fisher of Hobart, Tasmania (b. 1871) marry Alfred George Holding, and if so when and where did this marriage occur?

**Conclusion:** Frances Maria Fisher married Alfred George Holding on 23 February 1895 at the Cathedral Church of St. David (St. David's Cathedral), Hobart, Tasmania, under the rites of the Church of England, by licence. This conclusion is **proved**: the original signed marriage register supplies direct primary evidence, corroborated by an independent derivative index; all five GPS components are satisfied.

---

### Evidence

**Primary source — original signed marriage register (src_002)**

Entry No. 537 of the 1895 Register of Marriages for the District of Hobart, now held by the Tasmania Registrar-General, records this marriage in its original form. The image of the register page is accessible via FamilySearch at ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-99CH-CY6T. Full citation: Tasmania Registrar-General, "Register of Marriages, District of Hobart, 1895," entry no. 537 (Alfred George Holding and Frances Maria Fisher, 23 February 1895), image of original register page; FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-99CH-CY6T : accessed 9 September 2026), image filename: images/ark_61903_3_1_3QS7-99CH-CY6T.jpg.

This record is an **original source** (the actual contemporaneous register, not a copy or derivative), created by the officiating celebrant Rev. Canon F. T. Whitington, Assistant Incumbent, St. David's Cathedral, at the time of the event. It provides **primary information** for the marriage itself — the celebrant recorded the event he personally performed, and both parties signed the register in their own hands ("Alfred Holding Bachelor" and "Frances Maria Fisher Spinster"). Three witnesses also signed: J. Fisher, Sarah Ann Fisher, and John Fisher. The register entry is **direct evidence** for the marriage: it explicitly names the parties, states the date (23 February 1895), names the place (Cathedral Church of St. David, Hobart), identifies the denomination (Church of England), specifies that the ceremony was performed by licence, and records the celebrant.

The register records the groom Alfred George Holding as age 24, Bachelor, occupation Cabinetmaker. The bride Frances Maria Fisher is recorded as age 23, Spinster.

**Corroborating derivative source — FamilySearch civil registration index (src_001)**

The FamilySearch index of the Australia, Tasmania, Civil Registration, 1803–1933 collection (collection 2125029) contains two entries for this event — one from the bride's perspective (ARK ark:/61903/1:1:Q279-HRTF) and one from the groom's (ARK ark:/61903/1:1:Q279-HRRX) — both pointing to the same underlying register page. Full citation: "Australia, Tasmania, Civil Registration, 1803-1933," FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:Q279-HRTF : accessed 9 September 2026), entry for Frances Maria Fisher and Alfred George Holding, 1895.

This is a **derivative source**: FamilySearch indexers transcribed the register to create a searchable index, a process distinct from the original register's creation. The index is **primary information** for the marriage event (the indexers reported what the register contemporaneously recorded) and **direct evidence** for the marriage fact. Both index entries confirm the parties, the date (23 February 1895), and the place (Hobart, Tasmania). The derivative and original were created through different processes, making them independent evidence units that corroborate one another.

---

### Identity of the parties

**Bride — Frances Maria Fisher = LZZ9-YL3 (Francis Maria Fisher, b. 23 July 1871, Hobart)**

The record bride "Frances Maria Fisher" is identified as tree person LZZ9-YL3. The name "Frances" versus "Francis" is a documented nineteenth-century spelling variant in Tasmania civil registration; both forms appear in the same era and do not represent different persons. Sex (Female), location (Hobart, Tasmania), and a same-person similarity score of 0.92 all support the identification. The tree child LXW8-PVZ carries the surname Holding, born approximately 1898 in Hobart — a strong corroborating indicator that LZZ9-YL3 married into the Holding family consistent with this marriage record. The identification was linked at confident confidence from both the derivative index (pe_001–pe_004) and the original register (pe_011–pe_016).

**Groom — Alfred George Holding = I1 (new tree person minted from this record)**

The record groom "Alfred George Holding" is identified as tree person I1, a stub created from the groom persona in this record. No pre-existing tree person existed for the groom; I1 was minted directly from the derivative index persona and subsequently confirmed at confident confidence from the original register (pe_018–pe_024), where the groom signed his own name. The identification rests on the convergence of full name, age (24 at the February 1895 marriage, consistent with an approximate birth year of 1871), location, and marriage event across both evidence units.

---

### Discrepancy resolved

The derivative index (src_001) records the bride's birth year as 1872. The tree holds a birth date of 23 July 1871, sourced from a separate Tasmania civil birth registration. The original marriage register (src_002) records the bride's age as 23 at the time of the 23 February 1895 marriage. Because the bride's birthday (23 July) falls after the February marriage date, she had not yet turned 24 at the time of the ceremony — her age of 23 computes to birth year 1871, not 1872. The original register thus corroborates the tree's 1871 birth year and resolves the apparent discrepancy. The derivative index likely carried a transcription-rounding error converting from stated age to birth year. The original register takes precedence over the derivative index on this point, and the discrepancy does not affect the identity finding or the marriage conclusion.

This birth-year discrepancy does not touch the question's subject matter (the marriage event, date, and place) and does not affect the correlation of sources.

The reasoning is traceable, source classifications are explicit, the one discrepancy is addressed, and the conclusion is stated without hedging at the level the evidence supports.

---

**Conclusion restated:** Frances Maria Fisher (b. 23 July 1871, Hobart, Tasmania; tree person LZZ9-YL3) married Alfred George Holding (tree person I1) on 23 February 1895 at the Cathedral Church of St. David, Hobart, Tasmania, under the rites of the Church of England, by licence. This is proved by the original signed marriage register entry, Entry No. 537 of the 1895 Hobart District register, corroborated by independent derivative index entries in the FamilySearch civil registration collection.
